text:
Maya: Heads-up everyone — Game 7 tonight, 10:30pm. Thinking of turning the big room into a fan zone. Who's in for snacks and chaos? :hockey: :popcorn:

Eric: In. Ill bring a thermos of chili. Someone grab bread?

Zoe: I can bring buns and pretzels. Also down to stream if we have HDMI.

Dev: Ill run the projector. Need to know the stream link.

Carla: Quick pool idea: $5 winner takes the donut box. Loser does the next coffee run. Low stakes.

Maya: Love it. Add a tiebreaker: which player scores first?

Eric: Eric / Team North / chili / first goal: #77

Zoe: Zoe / Team South / pretzels + buns / first goal: #9

Dev: Dev / Team North / projector + HDMI / no snack / first goal: #12

Carla: Carla / Team South / cookies / first goal: #9

FoodBot: Nearby options: "Corner Cafe" 16" pizza $14, garlic knots $6, veggie platter $15. ETA 35-45 min. Suggest order at 21:40 for halftime delivery.

Maya: Ill handle ordering. Any dietary constraints? (gluten-free/vegan?)

Zoe: Vegan here — salad would be great.

Eric: Chili is meat but I can toss half into a separate container if helpful.

Dev: Stream link: https://example-cdn.live/game7 (works with projector). If that dies, try the backup link in #eng-streams.

Maya: Posted Google sheet: name / pick / snack / tiebreaker. Filling now.

Carla: Also, GIF prediction time. Mine: classic goalie save + slow-mo replay. :sunglasses:

Eric: GIF: goalie does the splits. Noted.

Zoe: If anyone wants to bring blankets, the big couches are getting cold.

Dev: I'll stash a couple in storage.

FoodBot: Order scheduled: 2x large pizza, garlic knots, veggie platter. Delivery note: 3rd floor kitchenette.

Maya: Nice. If we hit overtime, loser owes breakfast tomorrow. Stakes increased. :wink:

Carla: Signed. May the best bandwagon win.

Zoe: See you all at 10. Go team? Or go chaos.

Eric: See yall. Also, someone remind me to mute notifications once we start.

Dev: Ill handle muting the projector room phone.

Maya: Thanks team — this will be fun.
